```{r,echo=FALSE}
library(reticulate)
options(scipen=999)
abcd = sample(1:9,4)
a = abcd[1]*sample(c(-1,1),1)
b = abcd[2]*sample(c(-1,1),1)
c = abcd[3]*sample(c(-1,1),1)
d = abcd[4]*sample(c(-1,1),1)
cn = function(a,b){
  cn = gsub("+-","-",paste0(a,"+",b,"i"),fixed=TRUE)
  cn = gsub("0+0i","0",cn,fixed=TRUE)
  cn = gsub("+1i","+i",cn,fixed=TRUE)
  cn = gsub("-1i","-i",cn,fixed=TRUE)
  cn = gsub("+0i","",cn,fixed=TRUE)
  cn = gsub("-0i","",cn,fixed=TRUE)
  if(nchar(cn)>1 && substr(cn, start = 1, stop = 2)=="0+"){cn = gsub("0+","",cn,fixed=TRUE)}
  if(nchar(cn)>1 && substr(cn, start = 1, stop = 2)=="0-"){cn = gsub("0-","-",cn,fixed=TRUE)}
  return(cn)
}
cn1 = cn(a,b)
cn2 = cn(c,d)

cn3 = cn(a-c,b-d)
q1 = "z_1-z_2"
e1 = paste0("(",a,")-(",c,")=",a-c,collapse="")
e2 = paste0("(",b,")i-(",d,")i=",b-d,"i",collapse="")

rpo = c(a+c,a-c,-a+c,-a-c)
ipo = c(b+d,b-d,-b+d,-b-d)

ach = character()
for(rr in rpo){
    for(ii in ipo){
        ach = c(ach,paste0(cn(rr,ii)))
    }
}
ach = sort(unique(ach))


al = paste0("* $",ach,"$",collapse="\n")
sol = paste0(1*(ach==cn3),collapse="")


```

Question
========

Find the difference of the two complex numbers.
$$(`r cn1`)-(`r cn2`)$$

Answerlist
--------

`r al`

Solution
========

For subtraction, just subtract the real components $`r e1`$ and the imaginary components $`r e2`$.

$$`r cn3`$$
